A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E2 in the lower border (5 March 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-grapplinghook-PC-Errata-2022-D-E2-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Grappling Hook (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): The game text changes: “table. That” becomes “table and stack that”; “is played out but is then 'grappled' (placed here but is out of play). Any new” becomes “here. All”; “the same name” becomes “that title”; “now” is removed. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E2” in the lower border in place of the “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2022 D-E2 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
